tei:div.tei:p: (oṃ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbyer med pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob cing*/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa dus khyad par can gyi tshe/ rje btsun ma 'di nyid kyi sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'dod pas/ rang nyid kyi sgrub khang la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su/ chag chag dang*/ byi dor la sogs pa legs par bya/ bla ma dang rje btsun ma'i bris sku dang 'bur sku la sogs pa'i rten yod na tshul bzhin du bshams pa'i drung du/ 'thas zhing ngos snyoms pa'i sa gzhi'am/ stegs bu la sogs pa/ ba byung lnga dang dri bzang gi chus byug khru gang la sogs pa'i tshad kyi zlum skor bya/ de'i phyi rol du sor phyed tsam bskyed pa'i zlum skor gnyis pa bya/ nang gi zlum skor dang mthun par chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/ de la tshon bkye ba ni/ chos 'byung gnyis dmar po/ thig gi gcod mtshams re khā dkar po/ nang gi zlum skor dang chos 'byung gi bar gyi khyams rnams ljang gu/ mu khyung sngon po/ mu khyud kyi phyi nang gnyis ka'i re khā dkar po/

chos 'byung gnyis kyi dbus su zla gdan gyi steng du tshom bu dmar po bkod pa ni/ sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin la/ 'di nyid 'jug pa bde bar 'dod na ras sam/ dar dmar po la bris kyang rung*/ zhes kyang gsung*/ de'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa'i khar thod pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/ chang la sbrang ngam bu ram la sogs pa sbyar/ bdud rtsi ril bu'i phye ma btab pa dpral ba rang nyid la phyogs par bzhag de ni gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin/ de'i khar shing bu phra mos rgya gram byas la dar dmar gyis bkab/ de'i steng du me long ngam/ ma 'byor na shing leb la sogs pa'i khar/ sin+dhu ra tshags la btsags pa khod snyoms par bkram/ gser gyi thur ma'am med na rdo rje'i rtse mos chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su rgya yig gam/ bod yig gang yang rung bas bam̐ yig bris pa'i mthar/ mdun nas g.yon skor gyis oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng mgo phyir bstan 'khor yug tu bri/ de yang oṃ gsum dang*/ de'i rjes la sarba dang*/ bud+dha dang*/ ḍā ki dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ war+ṇa dang*/ nī ye dang*/ badz+ra dang*/ bai ro dang*/ tsa nī ye dang*/ hūm̐ gsum dang*/ phaṭa gsum dang*/ swā hā/ rnams rim bzhin bri ba ma gtogs 'bru re re nas zlog pa mi mdzad/ 'di la/ shar drang por/ oṃ dang*/ byang du ḍā dang*/ nub tu war+ṇa dang*/ lhor nī bris na cha snyoms par 'byung ngo*// mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re bri'o// de ni thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin no// de rnams kyi steng du dar dmar ram/ lwa dmar ram/ ras dmar gang yang rung ba'i gur khang legs par phub/ zan gtsang ma'i ril bu chung ngu la dar dkar gyi sdong bu btsugs pa 'bri mog gi mar khus kha dog bsgyur ba sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng ngam mdun phyogs gang rung du bzhag

de'i mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ phyogs mtshams re rer bkod pa g.yon skor du bshams/ sku bag can gyi gtor ma lnga tshar ram/ bsdu na gsum du byas pa maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun nam rgyab phyogs gang bde bar bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po kha rgyan dung chos rdor gzungs rnams tshang ba rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod me tog dang bcas pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i yo byad rnams kyang ma tshang ba med par bshams/ de dag ni cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chu chang gis sbyangs la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza kro ta ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lag pa g.yas g.yon dbus gsum bstan pa dang*/ bya khyung gi phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ phaiṃ/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dri sh+ya ho/ zhes brjod de/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'dzam bu gling na gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod brgyad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ de rnams la gtor ma phul bar bsam/ thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta/ pre ta/ pi sha tsi/ ud mā da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhiṃ/ me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dzigha tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra tā yā/ sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha ye/ sa hā yi kā bhan+du/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/

pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da bar gyis mchod/ nang mchod phul te/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la sogs pa gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa 'bul lo// zhes sogs brjod la/ dril bu chig brdung bya zhing*/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// rjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus par ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bus ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas kyis// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya che kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyis stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog

/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ de nas kyang bdag cag rnal 'byor pa 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs su gyur ba gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig sum+bha ni sogs brjod cing*/ rdo rje dril bu gsor dkrol drag tu bya/ gtor ma phyi'i sa gtsang sar dor ro// gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ sum+bha nis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa dang bar snang nam mkha' gang ba/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da hūm̐ gis bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes pas mang por spel/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nya pā ra mi ta/ nā da saṃ bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho/ a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ dang pos mchod yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ gnyis pas de dag gis gnas khang byin gyis rlabs/ gsum pas mchod pa byin gyis rlabs par bsams la/ rol chen bya/ de nas maṇ+ḍal zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad ma bde kye ltar byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gi dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug na zhugs pas/

nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon nas/ shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shre ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka ma mā+e muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus kyi mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ bdag bskyed rdzogs pa bzlas pa la thug gi bar du/ sgrub thabs kyi ngag 'don ltar nyams su blang*/ mdun gyi nang mchod mañdzi'i steng gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor dmigs te/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pi ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ ces pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor gsum char la dmigs te/ sum+bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ram̐ las me yi dkyil 'khor/ wam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/

sum̐ las ri rab kyi steng du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje rwa ba dang drwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad mda'i drwa ba dang*/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags phreng kha dog dmar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo rgyab tu bltab nas mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug mthur du brkyang nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas/ zhal gyen du phyogs par gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ langs tsho dar la babs cing*/ 'dod pa'i nu 'bur rgyas pa bde ba bskyed pa'i nyams can/

mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams su g.yon skor du lan gsum bskor zhing*/ ngag tu/ phaiṃ/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ de'i gnas rnams su/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ces pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/

mchod pa'i yul du mdun gyi nam mkhar/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas tshogs zhing khyad par spyan drangs/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ sum bha ni bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis rlabs/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wi ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha puts+tsha me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ pā d+yaṃ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi'i sngags brjod cing rol chen bya ba ni/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa'i mchod pa'o// 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba wi ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba la/ shab+da= gan+dhe= rā sa= spar+she rnams bcug pa ni phyi'i mchod pa ste/ so so'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pas 'bul lo// nang gi mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin brlabs dran par byas la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod kyi dbus nas blangs te/ thig pa 'thor zhing*/ oṃ mchod do// phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ an+tar ba/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham thing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/

mal lo ts+tsha ba blo gros grags pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan bzang po/ yar lung pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'dren mchog blo gros mchog 'phags/ rigs kyi bdag po kun dga' lung rigs/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag mnos/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bad+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ swā hā/ yi dam kyi lha rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug tu thig le bya/ phung khams skye mched lha'i ngor gsal ba bde bas tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ oṃ shrī mahā kā la ye/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shrī dharmā pā la tsa tur mu ṣa/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos skyong zhing bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' bsdod srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshan dho dang nye tshan dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ 'thung dpyod dang nye ba'i 'thung dpyod te/ yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku'i 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ rjed byed/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag yul bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas/ myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gis lce rtser myong la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod la gsung rdo rje mnyes par bsam pa ni nang mchod do// yid 'byung gi mchod pa ni/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ smon lam gyi dbang gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig

bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra sū ra sū ra a warta ya a warta ya ho/ na ma sa man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ a bhi sma ra ye s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dha tu a ka sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri shwa dha ye maṇ+ḍa la ma ma pra ṇi te/ puṇ+ye dz+nyā na wa len/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba len+ta/ ban+dha swa s+tha na ba len na tsā ya swā hā/ ces phyag rgyar bcas pa bya/ de nas bstod pa ni/ rol chen bya zhing*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra wā rā hi bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ār+ya a pa rā dzi te tre lo kya mā te mahā bīd+yā shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo sarba bhū ta bha ya ba he mahā badz+re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra a sa ni a dzi te a pa ra dzi te wa shaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi ṣa ni shwa ṣa ni ro ṣa ni kro dha kā rā li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na tra sa ni ma ra ni su pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bhi dza ye dzam+bha ni stam+bha ni mo hā ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra wā rā hī bam̐ mahā yo gi ni ka me shwa ri kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya ba dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sogs sh+lau ka gnyis dang*/ spros pa la dga' na/ ye shes chen po mdzod 'dzin chos kyi rje// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dad pa'i yid kyis cung zad bstod par bgyi// 'dab brgya'i lte bar nyin mor byed pa'i dbus// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'i spyan gsum g.yo// pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar rje btsun ma// mkha' spyod longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo// chags chen skyes bu 'dul bar bya ba'i phyir// brtan g.yo'i bdag po he ru ka dpal dang*// gnyis med lhan skyes gar gyis rol mdzad ma// mkha' spyod kha sbyor che la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid thugs zag pa med pa'i bde ba che// 'gyur med dga' bas gya nom bla na med// rgyun mi chad pa'i bde bas ros gang ma// mkha' spyod bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag chos dbyings spros bral nam mkha'i dbyings// mtha' yas yon tan mang pos nyer mdzes pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang rab ldan ma// mkha' spyod rang bzhin med la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin rnam par mi rtog kyang*// thugs rje chen pos sems can ma lus la// yid bzhin nor ltar dgos 'dod kun stsol ma// mkha' spyod snying rjes yongs gang phyag 'tshal lo// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i sa brnyes nas// rgyun chad med par 'gro ba'i don mdzad na// mkha' spyod rgyun chad med la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rjes gzhan gyis dbang bsgyur mas// 'khor ba ji srid gnas pa de srid du// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par rab bzhugs ma// mkha' spyod 'gog pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang bzhi'i don ldan bskyed rim zab mo'i don// thun bzhir bsgom zhing gus pas gsol btab pas// sku bzhi dbyer med zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku// mkha' spyod sku yis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gsum ldan pa'i gsang sngags yi ge'i tshogs// dus gsum ngag dang yid kyis rab bzlas pas// srid gsum sgra dbyangs rnam spang brjod bral gsung*// mkha' spyod gsung gis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bden gnyis rnam dag rdzogs rim dbu ma'i lam// sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir brtson pas legs bsgoms pas// don gnyis lhun grub 'gyur med bde ba'i thugs// mkha' spyod thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung nas// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do la sogs par// mkha' spyod chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog

/zhes rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i bstod pa sogs kyis bstod/ tshigs bcad rnams la/ g.yas pas rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs kas snying gar bzung*/ g.yon pas dril bu sh+lau ka'i mtshams su gsil bar bya'o// de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ sum bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i nang du/ e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dmar po zhes pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar bskyed/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra yo gi ni/ sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi la rol chen bya/ gong gi sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas gzungs thag bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste/ gzungs thag la 'khril nas song*/ rje btsun ma'i sku la phog pas/ ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi pa dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par bya'o// gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad mkha' spyod du khrid par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ dung chos kyi mchod yon phul la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bum nang gi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas bdag 'jug la/ mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma gnyis su med pa la/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum ltar dmigs la/ de thams cad dgongs pa rtse gcig pas/ bdag la dgongs par bsam te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sh+lau ka gcig gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes pas/ bum chu cung zad myang*/ rang gi lus longs spyod dus gsum gyi dge ba dang bcas pa yon du 'bul bar bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūm̐ nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la/ byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes yon phul nas/ gsol ba btab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje'i can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// ces pa lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de la rdo rje rnal 'byor mas mdzad par bsams la/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong bcings/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog phreng ba blang*/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor las khro mo khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dpag tu med pa 'phros te byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsams la/ ku shas bum chu rang la 'thor zhing*/

oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na grih+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+na pā ya gṛh+na pā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod lce la myangs pas lus sems bde bas gang*/ nang gi bar chad thams cad dag par mos/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// skal bzang bdag ni bde chen la'o// de yi bu la ci zhig bya// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes dang*/ rigs dang 'dun pa ched du bya ba dris shing nges par byas/ rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor bsams la/ de nyid rje btsun mas rdo rje snying gar bzhag nas/ brtan par byin gyis brlabs par bsams zhing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ zhes dang*/ su ra te sa ma ya staṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya tha su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ rnal 'byor mas gsang bar gdams par bsams la/ spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa 'di/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa thams cad kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i phyag na bsnams pa'i rdo rje la 'jus te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na rnal 'byor ma bzhugs pa'i drung du sleb par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pa ni phyi 'jug go /nang 'jug gi don du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i drung du yan lag bdun pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bsams la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum brjod/ rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par so so'i dam tshig gong 'phel du bzung bar bsams la/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ khyad par du g.yon pa'i kun spyod kyi dam tshig

spyir bud med la mi smod pa/ khyad par shes rab ma la brten pa'i dam tshig brgyad po bzung snyam pas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can// kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo// byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo// rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs// byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis dus 'di nas bzung ste// ji srid gnyis med la gnas par// de yi tshangs spyod gnyis med pa// nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bzung*// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam smin sha rus kyi bar du sbyangs te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e e las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ nas swā hā'i bar gyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong*/ rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur de rnams 'od du zhu nas tshur 'dus yig 'bru rnams la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lte bar/ e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su/ bam̐ yig dmar po/ mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa re re yod par bsams/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la mos gus chen pos gsol ba 'debs pa ni/

slob dpon rin po ches/ bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi dngos grub dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal zhing brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas/ de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa zhig dmar hril gyis byon nas/ rang gi khar thogs med du zhugs par bsams la ting lo'am/ mar me de nyid oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod cing*/ rang gi khar bcug pa'am bcug par bsams la/ rnal 'byor ma de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar la gar stabs mdzad cing*/ yar khyug mar khyug mdzad pa'i mthar lte ba'i bam̐ yig la thim pa de nyid rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// rang nyid phyi'i rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo nas tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor gyur/ ces pa'i bar brjod cing bsam pa ni/ lte ba'i bam̐ yig de nyid gdod nas nang gi phag mo yin pa la/ thabs 'dis gsal btab pa yin no// de nas mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rnams kyis dges pa'i gar mdzad/ sngags kyi sgra chen po sgrogs shing*/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par byon te/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim par bsams la/ oṃ gsum ma drag tu brjod cing*/ ḍā dril dkrol gu gul gyi dud pas bdug slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang*/ rje btsun ma'i sku dpag tu med pa byung ste/

rang gi spyi bor thim par bsams nas sngar bzhin sngags dang rol mo bya ba ni/ phyi'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs zhing dbab pa'o// rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po/ sbubs stong sbom phra mda' smyug tsam bsams pa'i ma snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du drag tu 'khor ba dbu ma'i nang nas yar gyen du bya 'phur ba bzhin snying ga'i bar du song bas/ lus sems bde bas khyab par bsam/ dbu ma'i yas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa kha dog dkar po g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar 'khor bzhin pas/ snying ga'i bar du byung bas snang ba thams cad stong nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsam/ dga' 'khyil de gnyis snying gar ro gcig tu 'dres pas bde stong gnyis med kyi ngo bo dga' 'khyil dmar skya shugs drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad cing*/ mthar de nyid kyang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin song bar bsam/ brjod med kyi ngang du ci tsam gnas kyi bar mnyam par bzhag pa ni/ gsang ba bde stong gnyis med kyi rnal 'byor ma ngo sprad pa yin no// zhes gsungs so// dhu dhu ra gu h+ya sa mā ya de ltar byin rlabs zhugs pa de rnams mi 'bral zhing brtan par bsams la/ lus kyi go cha'i sngags rnams dran pas/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hrīṃ moṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces tshar gcig brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod cing byin rlabs kyi myong ba la cung zad mnyam par bzhag me tog rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su phul ba'i stangs ka tsam bya/ me tog phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rje btsun mas rang gi spyi bor bzhag par mos la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha gṛh+na s+t+waṃ i maṃ satā mahā bā la/

zhes gsungs par bsams shing*/ spyi bor bzhag de ltar sems dang bam̐ lhan cig skyes pa'i phag mor ye nas gnas pa cho ga de dag gis gsal bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba la sgrib byed bsal ba'i mtshon byed du/ rnal 'byor mas gdong g.yogs dkrol bar mos te/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ pa hri traṃ/ khyed rnams rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor la ltos zhes gsung zhing*/ bltas pas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong bar mos/ de dag ni 'jug pa'i chos 'khor dang bcas pa'o// dngos gzhi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba la/ maṇ+ḍal bshams te/ maṇ+ḍal ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla zung zhig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la/ byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas yon du dbul/ rnal 'byor ma dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la de stsol cig /ces pa'am/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la/ rang skad cig gis rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i steng du/ gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin dpung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam/ phaiṃ zhes brjod pas rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar bkra lam gyis byon pa'i he ru ka yab yum gyi dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/

snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pa li la sogs pa'i dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod pa'i las brtsam mo// sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam la me tog 'thor zhing dril bu gsil bas/ he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i skumanga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi klad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e waṃ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes brjod/ de nas gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis zla ba ltar dkar ba'i bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba yal 'dab dang bcas pa cung zad yo bar 'dzin bzhin pas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// zhes pa nas de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ tsakra bi ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ kā kā s+ye/ u lu ka s+ye/ shwa na ka s+ye/ su kā ra s+ye/ ya ma dā dhi ya ma dhu dhi ya ma daṃ ṣ+ṭi ni ya ma mā thā ni/ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas rang gi spyi bo nas thim/ rang nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur ba la rje btsun ma 'khor bcas kyis rab gnas mdzad par bsams la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/

zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor ba ni dbang gi dngos gzhi'o// mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba kha dog dmar po chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul gyis thol nas byung*/ rje btsun ma'i zhal nas 'thon/ rang gi khar zhugs snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum brjod/ de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i yi dam gyi lhar bzung snyam pas me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rje btsun mas me tog phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhag cing gsung bar bsams la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod/ sin+dhu ra'i rdul tshon nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga rnams su thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i sku bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing*/ rje btsun mas gsung bar bsam/ gsang dbang gi don du dmigs pa 'di ltar byed de/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le thod pa'i nang du lhung ba/ rje btsun mas rang gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsam/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thod pa nas bdud rtsi blangs te rang gi lce thog tu bzhag mgrin pa'i lam nas myang bas/ lus kyi rtsa nang gi byang sems dam tshig pa'i tshul dang*/ dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa dbyings su dag cing gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam/

de ltar na gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag rnal 'byor ma'i gsung sngags bzlas brjod byed pa la dbang zhing*/ gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing*/ rje btsun mas gsung bar bsam/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa dpal he ru kar gyur pa dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i mkhar nang du sbyin par bsams nas/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gi rtses blangs la/ oṃ gsum ma brjod cing*/ lte ba/ snying ga mgrin pa/ dpral ba rnams su mas yar thig le bya/ mkha' nang gi byang chub kyi sems de nyid lte bar drangs pas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor thams cad byang chub sems kyis gang bas/ dga' ba'i ye shes nyams su myong*/ de bzhin du snying gar drangs pas snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gang bas/ mchog dga'i ye shes/ mgrin par drangs pas/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gang bas/ dga' bral gyi ye shes nyams su myong*/ spyi bor drangs pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ de'i tshe lus thams cad la rtsas khyab/ rtsa thams cad la byang chub sems kyis khyab/ byang chub kyi sems la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la stong pas khyab/ bde stong zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar bsam/ de ltar na thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag thugs gnyis med kyi ye shes bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes brjod cing gsung bar bsam/ dbang bzhi pa ni/ mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i zhal nas/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri ma med// stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes gsung bar bsam/

de'i don ni/ bden pa'i dngos po cung zad tsam yang ye nas yod ma myong ba'i chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bya ba de ni/ yod med rtag chad srid zhi'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bas/ nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ de'i ngo bo la gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa'i dri ma gdod ma nas gos ma myong bas dri ma med pa/ de lta bu'i yul stong pa nyid yul can gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i gnyis med ye shes kyi rdo rje/ stong pa nyid du bsgom/ zhes pas zung 'jug gi ngang du ci gnas mnyam par bzhag de ltar na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mtha' dag bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa yin no// zhes gsung bar bsam zhing brjod/ de ltar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa mtha' dag bsrung snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod/ byin rlabs thob pa'i bka' drin gyi yon du/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la/ byin rlabs zab mo thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// zhes sogs brjod/ lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul gyis cha shas nas longs spyod du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod/ de nas gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ gong du bshad pa'i bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ phaiṃ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ chos skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i mthar/ se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ gsum ma'i rjes la/ a kā ro mu khaṃ btags pa lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul la phyi nang gi mchod pa mdor bsdus/ dpal ldan mkha' 'gro ma sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis bstod pa bya/ dge ba 'dis sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyis smon lam dang bcas pa/ ḍā dril dang rol chen bya/ de nas mgon po che chung gi gtor ma sogs byed pa'am/ mdor bsdu na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas tshogs mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bla ma dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la phud phul/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams longs spyod/ lhag ma'i bar cho ga ji lta ba bzhin bya/ ༈ /rjes kyi cho ga ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gso zhing*/ phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs gsol ba btab pa dang bcas pa bum bskyed kyi skabs ltar bya/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum brjod cing*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ bris sku sogs rten rnams la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ brtan bzhugs bya/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod// zhes sogs nas badz+ra muḥ maṇ+ḍal gyi ye shes pa dang*/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo'i bar brjod/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags gnyis phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor gyis bsrung ba bya/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bde stong zlos gar ni// zhes pa sogs/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam bya/ phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang dbang paṇa chen nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i yum mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// rang bzhin 'od gsal gdod nas spros dang bral// brtan g.yo'i dngos kun spro dang bsdu mdzad ma// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku yi bkra shis shog /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rab mdzes chos kyi sku// drug cu'i dbyangs ldan theg mchog sgrog pa'i gsung*// ye shes lnga ldan bde gsal mi rtog thugs// lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bkra shis shog /sna tshogs zhing du sna tshogs gzugs sku yi// sna tshogs dbang gi sna tshogs gdul bya'i don// sna tshogs bsam pa ji bzhin bsgrub mdzad ma// zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku yi bkra shis shog /pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs rje btsun ma// 'dzum khro'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri thod legs 'dzin zhabs zung brkyang bskum tshul// sngags skyes mkha' spyod mchog gi bkra shis shog /gang gi rnam sprul grangs med bye ba phrag /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis tshogs rnams kyis// sgrub pa po yi bar chad kun sel zhing*// 'dod don dngos grub stsol ba'i bkra shis shog

/chos rje byams pa chos pas mdzad pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mngon dkyil las dang po pa rnams kyis tshes bcu sogs kyi skabs su/ nges par mkho ba'i ngag 'don/ lag len nag po 'gro shes kyi tshul du bkod pa 'di ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bu/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i dkyil chog rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa la gtso bor brten/ 'phags pa rin po che'i bdag 'jug dang*/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsung sgros/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpa' bzang po'i sgrub dkyil nas byung ba ltar/ rje bla ma'i gsung gi bdud rtsis cung zad kha brgyan nas/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo ring kun spangs pa chen po'i zhabs kyi pad mo spyi bos mchod pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis 'u yug grub pa'i gnas kyi gtsug lag khang du bkod pa 'dis kyang*/ bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus thams cad du dar shing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /yi ge pa ni rje bla ma de nyid kyi bran du gyur pa'i btsun pa mkhyen brtse dbang phyug gis bgyis pa'o// oṃ daṃ sha sa na sarba sa twa hi ho bha wan+tu/ i daṃ i thi/ maṅga lam// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
